title: feat: use just-git for the computer's git command
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Answers the shell's `git` command with [just-git](https://www.npmjs.com/package/just-git) (pure TS) instead of the built-in isomorphic-git CLI: adds `mv`, `rebase`, `cherry-pick`, `a..b` ranges, `--format`
- Hooks in via the Durable Object git client (`client.cli`), so no change to the prebundled shell
- Collective-memory push token now comes from a just-git credential provider inside the DO; still never reaches the shell. Replaces the push wrapper
- Without App secrets (or if minting fails) git stays anonymous, so clones keep working
- Drops the "push to your own repo with a token in the remote URL" instructions: just-git keeps URL credentials in memory only (not in `.git/config`)
- Test for mv/rebase/range/format; 17/17 pass. Bundle 6215 KiB / 1332 KiB gzip

Push verified on staging (a799fef0) via staging.gen.pollinations.ai/mcp/computer: clone, push and revert of a test file in collective-memory (9ba5877, 65a5034); `git mv` works.

gist.headline: Git grows new branches
gist.blurb: The computer's git command now runs on just-git, a pure TypeScript little shovel with more ways to rearrange the garden. Move files, rebase, cherry-pick, and inspect ranges without leaving credentials composting in config.
gist.summary: The computer MCP shell now routes git through the Durable Object's just-git client, adding mv, rebase, cherry-pick, a..b ranges, and --format while keeping collective-memory push credentials in memory.
gist.impact: Computer MCP users can use a broader git command set, and collective-memory clones remain anonymous when secrets are unavailable while authenticated push tokens never enter the shell or .git/config.
